idea-plugin.name: OneClickAPI
idea-plugin.description:
OneClickAPI - Generate a complete Spring Boot REST API from an @Entity or POJO class in one click. Free and open source.

Select one or many classes and get DTOs, mappers, repositories, services and controllers in seconds.

Features

  • Generate from JPA @Entity classes or plain POJOs (MyBatis)
  • Request/Response DTOs, MapStruct or manual mappers, repositories, services and controllers
  • Multi-class selection: generate APIs for many classes at once
  • Lombok support
  • Liquibase changelogs in XML or YAML
  • Image and PDF upload endpoints
  • Global exception handling
  • Never overwrites existing files

How to use

  1. Open a Spring Boot project.
  2. Select a class, then use File > New > Generate API or Code > Generate > Generate API (Cmd/Alt+N).
  3. Choose your options and click OK.
